priceSnapshot.note: Since the morning read (~$63,450) BTC drifted a touch lower, printing an intraday low near $63,173 before steadying in the $63,400-$64,000 band by early US afternoon. The $63,000 shelf continues to hold. The move is orderly and low-conviction: traders are sidelined ahead of the two-day FOMC that started today (decision Wednesday), and CME FedWatch hike odds have JUMPED to ~35.8% (from ~25.7% last week), a hawkish drift. Price sits in the lower half of the July box below the lost $64,050 shelf; the next bright magnet below is still ~$62,000 through thinner liquidity if $63,000 breaks.
